name: Tachibana Chitose
source:
2nd year high school student. The protagonist's classmate.
A shinigami who is with the 'Yomi' company.
A magical tanuki, whose specialty is transformation. A self-alleged girl, but they often take the form of a guy too. Their true original gender is a mystery.
A smug person who is always hitting on the protagonist with sweet words.
It seems before they became a shinigami they were a well off girl from a good family, but it seems they had a problem with them...?
[spoiler]He? has a non-romantic ending in the main game.[/spoiler]
